# Phase A, local inventory only

Run with Python 3 (beautifulsoup4 and tinycss2) and Node with Acorn available.
Set RELEASE_ACORN to the Acorn module path when not using the local lint toolchain.

    python scripts/release/build.py --source . --output /tmp/new-release --release-id audit-v1
    python tests/release/test_builder.py

Output must not exist and must be outside the source. Original application files
are byte-copied, not rewritten. index.html is an inventory member, NOT a generated
startup gate. Never serve this output as an approved runnable application.

The adjacent manifest.sha256 is a reproducibility check, not a trust root. A future
bootstrap must pin that digest independently before using any manifest.

All inventoried resources are conservatively marked required. This is not an
optimized shell/lazy/media policy. Generated index paths still refer to legacy
locations. The audit exposes unresolved imports and document-relative assignments;
it does not prove completeness of computed URLs or runtime DOM HTML/style strings.
Third-party resources are listed but not fetched, executed, or bundled.

This tool does not prepare CacheStorage, register a worker, contact Firebase,
create an entrypoint, solve v57 migration, modify G4, commit, push, or deploy.

The inventoryScope is declared-scope-inventory. audit.scopeReport records each root
entry, its inclusion, type and exclusion reason. htmlNotScanned lists unhandled
HTML resource mechanisms; no claim of complete dependency closure is made.
All import-map imports and scopes targets are audited without rewriting, and
query strings remain in references. MIME metadata uses a fixed extension table.
verify checks manifest schema, every resource byte/size, exact file set, and
rejects symbolic links in the release tree and its directory chain. An attacker
who can replace both manifest and its adjacent digest is not authenticated by it.

## Gateway implementation Stage1,local only

    python scripts/release/build.py --source . --output /tmp/gateway-build --gateway
    python scripts/release/build.py --output /tmp/gateway-build --source . --verify

This reuses the existing inventory builder. version-manifest.json preserves exact
logical query keys separately from immutable byte locations and records SHA256,
size,MIME,document/asset role and conservative no-store/nosniff response metadata.
Generation is derived from source-input hashes before output,not from a self-
referencing final artifact. All generated bytes are copied unchanged.
The output is inventory-only-not-selectable and offlineComplete=false. Findings,
external dependencies and engine/runtime exclusions remain explicit. Security
headers for documents need later review. No channel record,bootstrap,worker
integration,cache selection,FCM change or v57 migration is implemented here.
The digest beside the manifest checks consistency,not authenticity.

## Local gateway completion candidate

    python scripts/release/bootstrap.py --source . --output /tmp/new-gateway --epoch 1

This packages a separate fail-closed bootstrap and a transformed app entry in
an immutable release tree. It removes the old early registration and replaces
the old updater link in the generated app only. Source index.html stays intact.
The copied worker retains its original FCM prefix. That SDK is still external;
real FCM must never be inferred from SDK-stub tests. Do not deploy this output.

version-manifest.json hashes final packaged bytes. release-channel.json selects
it using a monotonic epoch. A rollback needs a higher epoch and rollback=true,
with a retained previously verified generation. Copying this directory to a
server is not an approved publication procedure. All required generations must
remain available;no automatic retirement is implemented. The legacy v57 HTML
cutover barrier and real-SDK/real-app integration remain release blockers.

The old manifest.json inventory is named source-inventory.json in this output,
so it is not confused with the install manifest served through the gateway.
The Stage1 builder verifier applies only to its original inventory output;
final packaged-manifest verification is performed by the packaging wrapper.

import argparse,importlib.util,json,shutil
from shell_identity import bind as bind_shell

SPEC=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('release_build',Path(__file__).with_name('build.py'))
builder=importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC);SPEC.loader.exec_module(builder)
from shell_assets import SHELL as BOOTSTRAP,write_static,static_files

def wrap(source,output,epoch=1):
 source=Path(source).resolve();output=Path(output).absolute();builder.build(source,output,'gateway-input',gateway=True)
 try:
  raw=json.loads((output/'version-manifest.json').read_text());old=raw['generation'];tree=output/'release'/old
  index=(tree/'index.html').read_text()
  registration_start=index.index('<script>\n// تسجيل مبكر');registration_end=index.index('</script>',registration_start)+len('</script>')
  index=index[:registration_start]+index[registration_end:]
  index=index.replace('<script src="js/updates-check.js"></script>','<script src="js/gateway-app-bridge.js"></script>')
  if 'js/updates-check.js' in index:raise ValueError('legacy updater still linked')
  (tree/'index.html').write_text(index)
  shutil.copyfile(Path(__file__).with_name('app-bridge.js'),tree/'js/gateway-app-bridge.js')
  write_static(source,tree)
  source_hashes=json.loads((output/'source-hashes.json').read_text())
  input_identity=builder.digest(builder.encoded(dict(schema=1,protocol=1,files=source_hashes,packaging={p.name:builder.digest(p.read_bytes())for p in [Path(__file__),Path(__file__).with_name('app-bridge.js'),Path(__file__).with_name('bootstrap-bridge.js'),Path(__file__).with_name('shell_assets.py'),Path(__file__).with_name('gateway-shell.css'),Path(__file__).with_name('shell_identity.py')]})))
  newtree=tree.with_name(input_identity);tree.rename(newtree);raw['generation']=input_identity;raw['inputIdentity']=input_identity;raw['status']='release-candidate-local'
  raw['resources'].append(dict(raw['resources'][0],requestKey='js/gateway-app-bridge.js',contentType='text/javascript',role='asset'))
  for resource in raw['resources']:
   path=resource['requestKey'].split('?')[0];body=(newtree/__import__('urllib.parse',fromlist=['unquote']).unquote(path)).read_bytes();resource.update(backing='release/'+input_identity+'/'+path,sha256=builder.digest(body),size=len(body))
  raw['resources'].sort(key=lambda r:r['requestKey'])
  raw['limits'].append('FCM SDK remains external;local packaging is not approved for deployment')
  manifest_bytes=builder.encoded(raw);(output/'version-manifest.json').write_bytes(manifest_bytes);(output/'version-manifest.sha256').write_text(builder.digest(manifest_bytes)+'\n')
  (output/'manifests').mkdir();(output/'manifests'/(input_identity+'.json')).write_bytes(manifest_bytes)
  (output/'release-channel.json').write_bytes(builder.encoded(dict(schema=1,epoch=epoch,generation=input_identity,manifest='manifests/'+input_identity+'.json',manifestSHA256=builder.digest(manifest_bytes),rollback=False)))
  (output/'manifest.json').rename(output/'source-inventory.json');(output/'manifest.sha256').rename(output/'source-inventory.sha256')
  write_static(source,output);(output/'index.html').write_text(BOOTSTRAP);shutil.copyfile(Path(__file__).with_name('bootstrap-bridge.js'),output/'bootstrap-bridge.js');(output/'firebase-messaging-sw.js').write_bytes(bind_shell((source/'firebase-messaging-sw.js').read_bytes(),(output/'index.html').read_bytes(),(output/'bootstrap-bridge.js').read_bytes(),static=static_files(source))[0])
  (output/'stage2.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(stage=3,deployable=False,FCM='external-not-runtime-tested',legacyV57Cutover='BLOCKED'),indent=2)+'\n')
  # Packaging changes entry bytes on purpose;verify final manifest directly,not old inventory metadata.
  for resource in raw['resources']:
   body=(output/__import__('urllib.parse',fromlist=['unquote']).unquote(resource['backing'])).read_bytes();assert builder.digest(body)==resource['sha256']and len(body)==resource['size']
  return dict(resources=len(raw['resources']),generation=input_identity,deployable=False)
 except Exception:shutil.rmtree(output);raise
if __name__=='__main__':
 parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--source',required=True);parser.add_argument('--output',required=True);parser.add_argument('--epoch',type=int,default=1);args=parser.parse_args();print(json.dumps(wrap(args.source,args.output,args.epoch)))
